## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest change that solves it.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run test`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run build:web` when web/discovery output changes
- [ ] `npm run test:webmcp` when browser-Agent behavior changes

## Calculation changes

If this PR changes BaZi, Zi Wei, Da Liu Ren, transit or time logic:

- [ ] I added/updated a reproducible fixture or test.
- [ ] I documented the time zone / solar-time / school convention involved.
- [ ] I did not hide cross-engine disagreement to force a preferred answer.

## Privacy

- [ ] No secrets or unnecessary personal birth/casting data are included in logs, fixtures, screenshots or telemetry.
